args.body: Take AUSTRALIAN-BUYER-DATA-QUALITY-PILOT if the latest mission records show no equivalent work. Prioritize a direct current buyer notice and run the acceptance sample as soon as the published scope and supplier conditions support it. A portal response or advertised value alone is insufficient evidence of a paid opportunity we can pursue.

description: The SQLite learner exercise reproduced the expected error and returned the expected row on SQLite 3.40.1. That gives the editorial mission a tested sample while publisher eligibility remains unresolved. Treasury has CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. Feedback shows zero classified requests and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. In parallel, test a separate route through one current Australian buyer notice for a small standalone data-quality job.
